name: core-mobile
description: COre for Android: talks to COre on your PC over Wi-Fi, or to Gemini when you're away.

scripts.android:add: npm run assets && npx cap add android && node scripts/patch-android.js
scripts.android:sync: npm run assets && npx cap sync android && node scripts/patch-android.js
scripts.android:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
